data.content_ref: inline:The headline claim asserts that the cyclic-symmetry restriction being ≥23 is 'the primary structural reason no rank-22 decomposition has been found.' This is a non-sequitur: an obstruction in the small symmetric subset of decompositions cannot explain why the vastly larger unrestricted search space—which includes all asymmetric decompositions—has yielded no rank-22 solution. The target's own transfer claim concedes that a null result would be 'evidence (not proof)' that the unrestricted minimum is 23, yet the headline claim leaps to 'the primary structural reason,' a causal explanation that does not follow from the evidence. The unrestricted search space failing to produce rank-22 could have entirely unrelated causes (algebraic degeneracy, border-rank gaps, other structural constraints) that have nothing to do with the symmetric subset's minimum.
